name: Maria Colosimo
bioAdditions: Maria died on 23 January 1845, aged 58 (born about 1787), and was buried the next day as the wife of Vincenzo Ferlaino (S1, S2). Both records name her parents as Andrea Colosimo and Carmela Cicco, who are new to the tree. Her 1809 marriage also names her father Andrea (S3).

relationships.evidence: Death records name father Andrea Colosimo

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Death, burial and marriage consistent; daughter Giuseppina's records name her.
